title: FEtoemc
description: A module capable of converting FE electrical energy from mechanical power and creative additions into equivalent EMC for exchange. (AI-generated)一个可以将机械动力：创想附加的FE电能转换为等价交换的emc的模组。（ai制作）
body:
A mod that can convert mechanical power: FE energy from Create mod into equivalent exchange EMC. (AI-made)

Added the FEMC converter block, which can store 10k FE of energy. Input FE is converted every 10 ticks (no conversion if the set value is not met). All converter blocks calculate in the same tick.

EMC value is given to the player who placed the block, compatible with the Equivalent Exchange team mods.

No crafting recipes added!

Conversion values can be edited in the config folder in fetoemc-common.toml (default: 50k FE converts to 5000 EMC).

The mod is theoretically compatible with any version of mechanical power and the Create mod.

Mod code made with DeepSeek v4, icons by Doubao, block drawings hand-drawn by the author, awa.

Updates are random (mainly because there's not much to add), still in testing, do not use on important saves.

Thanks for using it!

一个可以将机械动力：创想附加的FE电能转换为等价交换的emc的模组。（ai制作）

添加了FEMC转换器方块，方块自身可以存储10kfe的电，输入的FE每10tick进行一次转换（未满足设置数值不转换）所有转换方块同tick计算。

emc值会给予放置方块的玩家，兼容等价交换团队模组。

未添加合成表！

转换数值可通过config文件夹中的fetoemc-common.toml进行编辑。（默认每50kfe转换5000emc）

模组实现理论兼容任意版本的机械动力及创想附加模组

模组代码使用DeepSeek v4制作，图标使用豆包，方块作者手绘awa。

随缘更新（主要也没什么可加的了），测试阶段，不要在重要存档使用。

感谢使用！
